text: Skip to main content E-file information returns More In File Individuals Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) Forms W-2: E-file with SSA To e-file Forms W-2/W-2C, register with Business Services Online at SSA.gov . You can use IRS systems to electronically file most information returns . 10 or more returns: E-filing is required . How it works Choose an e-file option, then apply for a Transmitter Control Code (TCC) . E-file with IRIS File for free through the Information Returns Intake System (IRIS) Taxpayer Portal. Or use software through IRIS Application to Application (A2A). E-file with FIRE Software is required for the Filing Information Returns Electronically (FIRE) system. Form 1097 Forms 1098 Forms 1099 Form 3921 Form 3922 Forms 5498 Form 8027 Form 8596 Form 8955-SSA Form 1042-S Form W-2G E-file Affordable Care Act Forms with AIR Software is required for the Affordable Care Act Information Returns (AIR) system. Form 1094-B Form 1095-B Form 1094-C Form 1095-C Apply for a Transmitter Control Code (TCC) To e-file information returns with an IRS system, you need to apply for a TCC. This five-character, alphanumeric code identifies your firm or entity when you e-file. Don't delay in completing your TCC application. It may take to up 45 days for processing. Apply for a TCC to e-file with an IRS system: IRIS System — Information Returns Intake System (IRIS) Application for TCC IRIS TCCs start with 'D' FIRE System — Information Returns (IR) Application for TCC FIRE TCCs start with a numeric character AIR System — Affordable Care Act (ACA) Information Returns Application for TCC ACA TCCs start with 'B', 'C', or 'T' The responsible official listed on your application has access to view assigned TCCs. E-filing required for 10 or more returns As of tax year 2023, if you have 10 or more information returns, you must file them electronically. This includes Forms W-2, e-filed with the Social Security Administration . Find details on the final e-file regulations and requirements for Forms W-2 .
